_readme: THE SFX BANK (ELEMENTS.md §3, 2026-09-23). One row per file. A cue in a brief's `sfx` is picked by name — the row's id, else one of its tags — by machine/banks.py, and `{bank_id, file}` is written into plan.json. A row that is not `status: "made"` with a `file` is never picked; the gate names it instead. Room tone lives here too, as `room-tone-<setting>`, one bed per setting, looped.

`file` is the Drive path of the made audio, under Shared Assets/banks/sfx/. The rows marked "to make" are the target list: machine/make_bank.py --bank sfx --dry-run shows each request and what it would cost; nothing is made without an approved spend.
